  const lessons = LEVEL_LESSONS[levelId] || [];
  const done = lessons.filter(l=>state.completedLessons.has(l.id)).length;
  const pct = lessons.length ? Math.round(done/lessons.length*100) : 0;

  main.innerHTML = `
    ${topbarHtml(`Dashboard / <b>Nível ${lvl.label}</b>`)}
    <div class="level-tabs">
      ${LEVELS.map(l => `<div class="level-tab ${l.id===levelId?'active':''} ${(LEVEL_LESSONS[l.id]||[]).length?'':'locked'}" onclick="${(LEVEL_LESSONS[l.id]||[]).length?`openLevel('${l.id}')`:''}">${l.label}</div>`).join('')}
    </div>
    <div class="board-hero" style="--lvl-color:${lvl.color}">
      <div class="ic">${lvl.label}</div>
      <div>
        <h2>Nível ${lvl.label} — ${lvl.name}</h2>
        <p>${lvl.desc}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="prog"><div class="pct">${pct}%</div><div class="bar-track" style="height:6px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface-3);overflow:hidden;"><div style="height:100%;width:${pct}%;background:${lvl.color};border-radius:6px;"></div></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="lesson-row head"><div style="width:32px"></div><div style="flex:1">Aula</div><div>Status</div></div>
    ${lessons.length ? lessons.map((l,i) => `
      <div class="lesson-row ${state.completedLessons.has(l.id)?'done':''}" onclick="openLesson('${l.id}')">
        <div class="num">${state.completedLessons.has(l.id)?'✓':(i+1)}</div>
        <div class="info"><b>${l.title}</b><span>${l.subtitle}</span></div>
        <div class="chk">${ICN.chevR}</div>
      </div>
    `).join('') : `
      <div class="empty-state">
        <div class="ic">${ICN.lock}</div>
        <h3>Em construção</h3>
        <p>As aulas do nível ${lvl.label} ainda estão sendo criadas e serão adicionadas em breve.</p>
      </div>
    `}
  `;
}

/* ============================================================
   LESSON VIEWER
   ============================================================ */
const LESSON_TABS = [
  {key:'objective', label:'Objetivo'},
  {key:'vocab', label:'Vocabulário-chave'},
  {key:'expressions', label:'Expressões úteis'},
  {key:'grammar', label:'Gramática aplicada'},
  {key:'dialogue', label:'Diálogo'},
  {key:'interview_questions', label:'Perguntas de entrevista'},
  {key:'model_answers', label:'Respostas modelo'},
  {key:'exercise', label:'Exercício prático'},
  {key:'roleplay', label:'Role-play'},
  {key:'homework', label:'Homework'},
  {key:'quiz', label:'Quiz'},
  {key:'checklist', label:'Checklist'},
];

let seenTabs = new Set();

function findLesson(id){
  for(const key of Object.keys(LEVEL_LESSONS)){
    const found = LEVEL_LESSONS[key].find(l=>l.id===id);
    if(found) return found;
  }
  return null;
}

function openLesson(id){
  currentLessonId = id;
  currentView = 'lesson';
  currentLessonTab = 0;
  seenTabs = new Set([0]);
  renderLessonViewer();
  renderSidebar();
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

function renderLessonViewer(){
  const l = findLesson(currentLessonId);
  if(!l) return;
  const main = document.getElementById('main');
  const lvl = LEVELS.find(x=>x.id===l.level);
  const lessons = LEVEL_LESSONS[l.level];
  const idx = lessons.findIndex(x=>x.id===l.id);
  const prev = lessons[idx-1], next = lessons[idx+1];

  const pager = `
    <div class="lesson-pager">
      <button class="icon-btn ${prev?'':'disabled'}" ${prev?`onclick="openLesson('${prev.id}')"`:'disabled'} title="Aula anterior">${ICN.chevL}</button>
      <span class="lp-label">Aula ${idx+1} de ${lessons.length}</span>
      <button class="icon-btn ${next?'':'disabled'}" ${next?`onclick="openLesson('${next.id}')"`:'disabled'} title="Próxima aula">${ICN.chevR}</button>
    </div>`;

  main.innerHTML = `
    ${topbarHtml(`<a onclick="openLevel('${l.level}')">Nível ${lvl.label}</a> / <b>${l.title}</b>`, pager)}
    <div class="lesson-photo"><img src="${lessonPhotoFor(l)}" alt=""></div>
    <div class="lesson-head">
      <div>
        <div class="eyebrow">Nível ${lvl.label} · Aula ${l.number}</div>
        <h2>${l.title}</h2>
        <p>${l.subtitle}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="mark-complete-toggle ${state.completedLessons.has(l.id)?'done':''}" onclick="markLessonComplete('${l.id}')">${state.completedLessons.has(l.id)?'✓ Concluída':'Marcar como concluída'}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="lesson-layout">
      <div class="lesson-nav-rail">
        <div id="railList">
          ${LESSON_TABS.map((t,i)=>`
            <div class="rail-item ${i===currentLessonTab?'active':''} ${seenTabs.has(i)?'seen':''}" onclick="setLessonTab(${i})">
              <span class="rn">${seenTabs.has(i)?'✓':(i+1)}</span><span>${t.label}</span>
            </div>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="lesson-main">
        <div id="lessonPanel"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="side-rail">
        <div class="mini-card">
          <h4>Nível</h4>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">
            <div style="width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:${lvl.color};color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;">${lvl.label}</div>
            <div style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);">${lvl.name}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="mini-card">
          <h4>Dica rápida</h4>
          <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.6;">${l.expressions && l.expressions[0] ? '"' + l.expressions[0].en + '" — ' + l.expressions[0].pt : 'Pratique em voz alta para ganhar confiança.'}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  renderLessonPanel(l);
}

function setLessonTab(i){
  currentLessonTab = i;
  seenTabs.add(i);
  document.querySelectorAll('.rail-item').forEach((el,idx)=>{
    el.classList.toggle('active', idx===i);
    el.classList.toggle('seen', seenTabs.has(idx));
    el.querySelector('.rn').textContent = seenTabs.has(idx) ? '✓' : (idx+1);
  });
  const l = findLesson(currentLessonId);
  renderLessonPanel(l);
}

function renderLessonPanel(l){
  const key = LESSON_TABS[currentLessonTab].key;
  const el = document.getElementById('lessonPanel');
  let html = '';
  switch(key){
    case 'objective':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Objetivo da aula</h4><p class="objective-text">${l.objective}</p></div>`;
      break;
    case 'vocab':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Vocabulário-chave</h4><div class="vocab-list">${l.vocab.map(v=>`
        <div class="vocab-item"><div class="term">${v.term}</div><div class="pt">${v.pt}</div><div class="ex">"${v.ex}"</div></div>
      `).join('')}</div></div>`;
      break;
    case 'expressions':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Expressões úteis</h4>${l.expressions.map(e=>`
        <div class="expr-item"><div class="en">${e.en}</div><div class="pt">${e.pt}</div></div>
      `).join('')}</div>`;
      break;
    case 'grammar':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Gramática aplicada</h4>${l.grammar.map(g=>`
        <div class="grammar-block"><h5>${g.title}</h5><div class="expl">${g.explanation}</div>
          <ul class="examples">${g.examples.map(ex=>`<li>${ex}</li>`).join('')}</ul>
        </div>
      `).join('')}</div>`;
      break;
    case 'dialogue':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Diálogo</h4>${l.dialogue.map(d=>`
        <div class="dialogue-line ${d.sp==='B'?'b':'a'}"><div class="who">${d.sp}</div>
          <div class="bubble"><div class="en">${d.en}</div><div class="pt">${d.pt}</div></div>
        </div>
      `).join('')}</div>`;
      break;
    case 'interview_questions':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Perguntas de entrevista</h4>${l.interview_questions.map(q=>`
        <div class="qa-item"><div class="q">${q.q}</div><div class="qpt">${q.pt}</div></div>
      `).join('')}</div>`;
      break;
    case 'model_answers':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Respostas modelo</h4>${l.model_answers.map(m=>`
        <div class="qa-item">
          <div class="q">${m.q}</div>
          <div class="a-tier"><div class="tier-label">Resposta modelo</div><div class="txt">${m.answer}</div></div>
          <div class="a-tier"><div class="tier-label">Em português</div><div class="txt">${m.pt}</div></div>
        </div>
      `).join('')}</div>`;
      break;
    case 'exercise':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Exercício prático</h4><div class="instr" style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-bottom:14px;">${l.exercise.instructions}</div>${l.exercise.items.map((it,i)=>`
        <div class="exercise-item"><div class="q">${i+1}. ${it.q}</div>
          <div class="opt-row">${it.options.map((op,oi)=>`<button class="opt-btn" onclick="checkExOption(this, ${oi}, ${it.correct})">${op}</button>`).join('')}</div>
        </div>
      `).join('')}</div>`;
      break;
    case 'roleplay':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Role-play</h4><div class="roleplay-box">
        <span class="instr-badge">${l.roleplay.instructions}</span>
        <div class="scenario">${l.roleplay.scenario}</div>
        ${l.roleplay.script.map(d=>`
          <div class="dialogue-line ${d.sp==='B'?'b':'a'}"><div class="who">${d.sp}</div>
            <div class="bubble"><div class="en">${d.en}</div><div class="pt">${d.pt}</div></div>
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div></div>`;
      break;
    case 'homework':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Homework</h4><div class="homework-box"><ul>${l.homework.map(h=>`<li>${h}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div></div>`;
      break;
    case 'quiz':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Quiz</h4>${l.quiz.map((q,qi)=>`
        <div class="quiz-item"><div class="q">${qi+1}. ${q.q}</div>
          <div class="opt-row">${q.options.map((op,oi)=>`<button class="opt-btn" onclick="checkExOption(this, ${oi}, ${q.correct})">${op}</button>`).join('')}</div>
        </div>
      `).join('')}</div>`;
      break;
    case 'checklist':
      html = `<div class="panel"><h4>Checklist de aprendizado</h4>${l.checklist.map((c,i)=>`
        <label class="checklist-item"><input type="checkbox"><span>${c}</span></label>
      `).join('')}</div>`;
      break;
  }
  el.innerHTML = html;
}

function checkExOption(btn, chosen, correct){
  const row = btn.parentElement;
  [...row.children].forEach(b=>b.classList.add('disabled'));
  if(chosen===correct){ btn.classList.add('correct'); }
  else{
    btn.classList.add('wrong');
    row.children[correct].classList.add('correct');
  }
}

function markLessonComplete(id){
  if(state.completedLessons.has(id)) return;
  state.completedLessons.add(id);
  saveState();
  pushProgressToServer();
  renderLessonViewer();
  renderSidebar();
}

/* ============================================================
   UTIL
   ============================================================ */
function escapeHtml(s){
  return (s||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
}

/* ============================================================
   STATIC NAV (rendered once, uses ICN which is defined above)
   ============================================================ */
document.getElementById('navTop').innerHTML = `
  <div class="nav-item" data-nav="home" onclick="go('home')"><span class="ic">${ICN.home}</span><span class="lbl">Dashboard</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" data-nav="foundations" onclick="go('foundations')"><span class="ic">${ICN.compass}</span><span class="lbl">Fundamentos</span></div>
`;
document.getElementById('navResources').innerHTML = `
  <div class="nav-item locked"><span class="ic">${ICN.grid}</span><span class="lbl">Trilhas de carreira</span><span class="badge">em breve</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item locked"><span class="ic">${ICN.help}</span><span class="lbl">Banco de perguntas</span><span class="badge">em breve</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item locked"><span class="ic">${ICN.mic}</span><span class="lbl">Mock interviews</span><span class="badge">em breve</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item locked"><span class="ic">${ICN.award}</span><span class="lbl">Certificações</span><span class="badge">em breve</span></div>
`;

/* ============================================================
   INIT
   ============================================================ */
loadState();
if(state.name){
  document.getElementById('gate').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('app').classList.add('show');
  boot();
  syncProgressFromServer();
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
